notes: The (L+1)*f recurrence needs no body over 4 atoms, but its running max does, so this uses run boundaries instead. Steps: break flags by rotate-fold (end sentinel true), positions 1..n by the prefix-adder idiom, (p b) pairs by a zip fold, keep the breaks, add a 0 in front, gaps by rotate-fold, and the largest gap by the filter-fold max idiom.
